title: The Jones house
description:
A quick 15 minutes from the Airport if you take Braily pkwy. 5 minutes to the studim, 5 minutes to Broadway, 8 minutes to opryland 5 minutes to golf world it is the best location to go anywhere, if you take Ellington hwy.

The space
3 bed rooms and 2&1/2 bathrooms with 2 living room one upstairs & one downstairs. A kichen with small bar to get together and have fun, You can also, enjoy the 3 1/2 acres of backyard  behind the house, have a wilderness feeling while you're in downtown.

Guest access
Use the carport entrance, to get your keys. Feel free to walk the 3 1/2 acres of wood in the back of the house.

Other things to note
Free coffee and tea Will be available. Call me 615-335-6479 for any help you may need.
